properties.Dollar_Volume:
SELECT *,
((prix_cloture - prix_ouverture) / CAST(prix_ouverture AS DOUBLE)) * 100 AS variation,
(prix_haut - prix_bas) AS volatilite,
(volume * prix_cloture) AS dollar_volume
FROM FLOWFILE
